experiences.description:
•	Built National PR expansion strategy that included branded events, media, influencer and analyst relations 
•	Managed B2B PR Campaigns, identified story ideas and drafted pitches that developed relationships with key technology media and secured coverage in key Canadian publications and trade publications 
•	Increased Agreement Express’ brand profile and provided strategic direction to the executives to develop image through speaking opportunities, contributed articles and presentations 
•	Worked with HR to develop People & Culture Committees in the Vancouver and Toronto offices 
•	Amplified brand voice and increased share of voice in core verticals through PR and Events
•	Planned and executed integrated marketing campaigns for 25+ tradeshows and conferences each year 
•	Assisted with content for the blog and compiled a Fintech trend Report with influencer predictions. The industry insights and statics were used throughout events, emails and social campaigns

•	Managed a fast-paced, deadline-driven workload for up to eight accounts across key verticals including Fintech, technology and consumer products 
•	Responsible for client relations, strategic direction and team management for all accounts
•	Conducted media training, created in-depth media briefings and advised on media interviews 
•	Managed and directed PR Account Associates and Senior PR Account Associates on account execution including: media list building, creative writing, media relations, event management, digital, and reporting
•	Managed account priorities and balance deadline-driven work load with complete accuracy
•	Designed and directed event management and digital strategy
•	Maintained regular client communication and ensured consistent results on a monthly basis
•	Designed and tracked appropriate metrics to track success
•	Proactive about account needs and identifying necessary improvements and recommendations 
•	Evaluate PR Account Associates and Senior PR Account Associates performance as well as mentored associates to achieve growth.
